answer: Mesa-Lagoon Sensor Anchor: each fake costs one $240 buoy. Every identity must own a real sensor - a lagoon buoy or a mesa ridge station - streaming signed water and wind readings every hour. Neighbors cross-check each reading against their own: a buoy reporting lagoon water at 40C while its neighbors read 12C fails the velvet-smooth consensus band and its bond burns. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 buoys in 1,000 real places, $240,000 of hardware no bot farm can rent. Limit: a farm that owns real coastline could pass; the check catches cheap fakes, not rich ones.
